name: Quote card
description: A quotation with a large quotation mark, the author and their role; for testimonials, famous quotes and pull quotes.

params.name: quote
params.help: The quote itself, without quotation marks. Best under 200 characters; longer text gets smaller and is cut after 5 lines

params.name: author
params.help: Who said it (empty: no author line)

params.name: role
params.help: Their role, company or source, shown after the author

example.quote: The best way to predict the future is to invent it.
example.author: Alan Kay

update.quote: Simple things should be simple, complex things should be possible.
update.author: Alan Kay
